notes: Jetchat, the Material 3 chat sample. :app declares 21 @Preview functions, all catalogued. The theme entry passes isDynamicColor = false so the chips show Jetchat's own palette rather than the host's dynamic colour. Two previews are excluded, with no catalog entries: MessagesWidget.kt's MessageItemPreview and WidgetPreview put androidx.compose.ui.tooling.preview.Preview on Glance composables, which cannot run under the Compose UI applier (IllegalStateException: Invalid applier) — an upstream bug, since a Glance preview needs androidx.glance.preview.Preview, so they fail in Android Studio too. 21 of 23 renders (19 functions catalogued of 21). Built from UNMODIFIED upstream android/compose-samples (main), replacing the catalog preview.coo.ee served from the yschimke/compose-samples fork: that fork's `previews` branch carried roughly ten thousand lines of catalog-only preview sources that no longer apply to upstream, and none of them is carried over — this import renders upstream's own @Preview functions only, and every spec entry names one. The Theme control comes from the sample's own theme composable via `themes` in the spec, replacing the fork's re-themed Material 3 tab. Each sample is its own Gradle build in a subdirectory of the repository, hence workingDirectory. Licence: Apache-2.0.
